description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would spend Vitae you do not have.

Draw 2 emergency Vitae instead, enough to cover the cost. This Vitae comes with a price: you take persistent bleed damage equal to your level until treated, as your body cannibalizes itself to produce it.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, drawing 2 emergency Vitae the actor doesn't have and auto-converting the debt to a damage-over-time condition has no rule-element hook; SpecialResource's schema has no debt/negative-balance mechanism.
